name: Metropolis Reformer
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
You have hexproof.
Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you gain that much life.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "you") giving the controller hexproof: the player can't be the target of spells or abilities their opponents control (702.11c), lasting while the permanent is on the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The grant_keyword static and grant_keyword op only reach permanents through affects/objects selectors, and no static in static_effects carries affects_player for hexproof; grant_protection takes a player but protection is a different rule (it also prevents damage and blocks targeting by everything with a quality), and ward/shroud are likewise permanent-only. The engine source has no player-hexproof check in targeting
